# MetrAIyux 0S Public Claims Ledger

## Website posture

This website is a public-facing explanation and routing layer for MetrAIyux 0S. It should explain what the system does, route visitors into the correct surface, and keep private owner/operator rooms protected.

## Safe public claims in this package

- MetrAIyux 0S is positioned as a protected sovereign operating layer.
- The public website routes visitors toward command, customer workspaces, revenue lanes, proof surfaces, live route directories, and contact paths.
- The site references the operating model around 16 operating brains, 13 cabinets, customer workspaces, proof ledgers, governed AI, and owner command.
- The public copy avoids claiming that every private provider, customer, payment flow, legal-sensitive flow, or live integration is fully verified in public.

## Required proof behavior

Use live route inspection, operator ledgers, smoke tests, and private provider verification before making stronger production claims in sales collateral.
